issue.title: Stabilize RefsPanelModelTests refresh-reorder timeout on macOS CI
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-5x.4 note #2. RefsPanelModelTests::testRefreshReordersFromNewDataKeepingSelection failed in macOS CI run 37962741576 (fec4293), and both attempts of 37971680341 (d808c6d), with model condition not met before the 5-second waitForModel deadline. The same test passed in 37968034913 (37b914c) and 37973573511 (8c10d52, 0.048 seconds); the test body is unchanged, and d808c6d..8c10d52 changes no Refs source or Refs fixture branch. These are cross-SHA observations, not a claimed same-SHA green rerun. Inspect whether late initial git-date publication can consume the manual-refresh rerank before its new snapshot starts. Compare testOpenRefreshesTodayWithoutRefreshingSnapshot, which waits for the git-added date before modifying its baseline. Confirm the root cause before applying a test-only settlement change or changing production refresh sequencing. Preserve selection and frozen-list behavior; do not just extend the timeout. This defect predates the scan service and UI, and active capture/ref-parent epics did not cause it.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed: 37962741576/fec4293 and 37971680341/d808c6d twice. Passed: 37968034913/37b914c and 37973573511/8c10d52. Test body unchanged; Refs source and fixture branch unchanged between last failing and passing SHA. No same-SHA green rerun or isolated serial reproduction established; full-suite scheduling is a suspected factor. Audited CI excerpts attached.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: swift test --filter RefsPanelModelTests.testRefreshReordersFromNewDataKeepingSelection (macOS 26; also observe full CI suite)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5x.4 proposed this pre-existing refresh-order timeout; the land audit confirmed failing and passing macOS observations with unchanged Refs test behavior, so it needs separate investigation.
